title: Wh- questions in the past simple

objective.en: Ask Wh- questions about the past with did, including how long, how much, what time and a final preposition: Where did you go? Who did you go with?
objective.fr: Poser des questions avec un mot interrogatif au passé avec did, y compris how long, how much, what time et une préposition finale : Where did you go ? Who did you go with ?
objective.de: Wh-Fragen über die Vergangenheit mit did stellen, auch mit how long, how much, what time und einer Präposition am Ende: Where did you go? Who did you go with?

label.fr: Mot interrogatif + did + forme de base

instructions.en: Read the explanation and the examples.
instructions.fr: Lisez l’explication et les exemples.
instructions.de: Lies die Erklärung und die Beispiele.

text.en:
To ask about the past, put a question word first, then `did`, then the subject, then the **base form** of the verb: `Where did you go?` `What did she buy?`

- Question words: **where**, **when**, **why**, **what**, **who**, **how**.
- `did` already shows the past, so the verb stays in the base form: `Where did you go?`, not `Where did you went?`
- The order is the same for every subject: `Why did he leave?` `When did they arrive?`
text.fr:
Pour poser une question sur le passé, mettez d'abord un mot interrogatif, puis `did`, puis le sujet, puis la **forme de base** du verbe : `Where did you go?` `What did she buy?`

- Mots interrogatifs : **where** (où), **when** (quand), **why** (pourquoi), **what** (quoi), **who** (qui), **how** (comment).
- `did` marque déjà le passé, donc le verbe reste à la forme de base : `Where did you go?`, et non `Where did you went?`
- L'ordre est le même pour tous les sujets : `Why did he leave?` `When did they arrive?`
text.de:
Um nach der Vergangenheit zu fragen, steht zuerst ein Fragewort, dann `did`, dann das Subjekt, dann die **Grundform** des Verbs: `Where did you go?` `What did she buy?`

- Fragewörter: **where** (wo), **when** (wann), **why** (warum), **what** (was), **who** (wer), **how** (wie).
- `did` zeigt schon die Vergangenheit, deshalb bleibt das Verb in der Grundform: `Where did you go?`, nicht `Where did you went?`
- Die Reihenfolge ist für jedes Subjekt gleich: `Why did he leave?` `When did they arrive?`

label.en: How long, how much, what time and prepositions
label.fr: How long, how much, what time et prépositions
label.de: How long, how much, what time und Präpositionen

instructions.en: Read the explanation and the examples.
instructions.fr: Lisez l’explication et les exemples.
instructions.de: Lies die Erklärung und die Beispiele.

heading.en: More detail, and the final preposition
heading.fr: Plus de précisions, et la préposition finale
heading.de: Mehr Einzelheiten und die Präposition am Ende

text.en:
You can ask for more detail with **how** or **what** plus another word, in front of `did`:

- **how long** (time): `How long did you stay?`
- **how much** or **how many** (quantity): `How much did it cost?` `How many photos did you take?`
- **what time** (the clock): `What time did you get up?`

In everyday English the preposition goes at the end: `Who did you go with?` `What did you talk about?`
text.fr:
Vous pouvez demander plus de précisions avec **how** ou **what** plus un autre mot, devant `did` :

- **how long** (la durée) : `How long did you stay?`
- **how much** ou **how many** (la quantité) : `How much did it cost?` `How many photos did you take?`
- **what time** (l'heure) : `What time did you get up?`

En anglais courant, la préposition se place à la fin : `Who did you go with?` `What did you talk about?`
text.de:
Mehr Einzelheiten erfragst du mit **how** oder **what** plus einem weiteren Wort vor `did`:

- **how long** (Dauer): `How long did you stay?`
- **how much** oder **how many** (Menge): `How much did it cost?` `How many photos did you take?`
- **what time** (Uhrzeit): `What time did you get up?`

Im Alltagsenglisch steht die Präposition am Ende: `Who did you go with?` `What did you talk about?`

translation.de: Um wie viel Uhr bist du aufgestanden?
